FN-52A1363-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 98
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 98 as reported by the Committee on Education Policy would increase the
administrative and financial obligations of the State Board of Education by an undetermined
amount to adopt rules implementing and administering the provisions of this bill which include:
(1) providing for the inspection of every school facility at least once every five years; (2)
establishing and updating the criteria for school security inspections; (3) providing requirements
for the selection of school security inspectors; (4) developing applications for, and awarding
grants to assist local boards of education in complying with school security criteria and fire
safety recommendations; and (5) developing procedures for the newly created School Security
and Fire Safety Fund.
Further, this bill would require the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA) to adopt rules to
implement and administer the School Mapping Data Program, for the purpose of producing
mapping information for each public school for dissemination to local, county, state and federal
public safety agencies, subject to the appropriation of funds by the Legislature for this purpose.

FN-52A1363-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 98
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/29/2024
Senate Bill 98 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of the State Board of
Education by an undetermined amount to implement and administer the provisions of this bill
which include: (1) providing for the inspection of every school facility at least once every five
years; (2) establishing and updating the criteria for school security inspections; (3) providing
requirements for the selection of school security inspectors; (4) developing applications for, and
awarding grants to assist local boards of education in complying with school security criteria
and fire safety recommendations; and (5) developing procedures for the School Security and
Fire Safety Fund created by this bill within the State Treasury.
Further, this bill would increase the obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency
(ALEA) by an undetermined amount to implement and administer the School Mapping Data
Program, created by this bill for the purpose of mapping each public school for dissemination to
local, county, state and federal public safety agencies.

FN-52A1363-4
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 98
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 05/02/2024
Senate Bill 98 as reported by the Committee on Education Policy would increase the obligations
of the State Board of Education by an undetermined amount to implement and administer the
provisions of this bill which include: (1) providing for the inspection of every school facility at
least once every five years; (2) establishing and updating the criteria for school security
inspections; (3) providing requirements for the selection of school security inspectors; (4)
developing applications for, and awarding grants to assist local boards of education in
complying with school security criteria and fire safety recommendations; and (5) developing
procedures for the School Security and Fire Safety Fund created by this bill within the State
Treasury.
This bill would also increase the administrative obligations of the local boards of education by
requiring each employee designated as a district safety coordinator to complete annual training
and to administer the provisions of this bill.
Further, this bill would increase the obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency
(ALEA) by an undetermined amount to implement and administer the School Mapping Data
Program, created by this bill for the purpose of mapping each public school for dissemination to
local, county, state and federal public safety agencies.
